title: IE40005: Advanced Sensing Techniques
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basics of MEMS and microfabrication, Basics of NEMS and nanomanipulation. Smart
sensors and actuators. Micro pH and temperatures sensors fabricated on CMOS
technology. CAD for sensors.Smart materials: Electroactive polymers, Shape
memory alloy, Magnetorheological and Electrorheological fluids, hysteresis in
smart materials, Sensor Modelling and control: Origin, Simulation and Modelling
of smart sensors- static and dynamic (FD, FEM), Feedback mechanism and active
control. Signal conditioning and interfaces for sensor: IEEE 1451 standard for
smart transducer interfacing, signal conditioning and conversion, calibration,
linearization and basic sensor communications.Distributed and multidimensional
sensing techniques: Tomograhic sensing technique and measurement Ã¢ÂÂ process
and medical, sensor networking Ã¢ÂÂ data fusion and 2-D, 3-D
measurement.Biosensors: mono and multi enzyme biosensors, enzyme based affinity
biosensors, electrochemical immunosensors, Cell and tissue based sensors,
biochips and biosensor arrays. Application of Biosensors: Clinical application
(glucose monitoring), Implantable sensing (drug monitoring), process control
(food monitoring).
